context: Kenji starts to publish manga online; Ren helps him set up.
purpose: Younger man helping mentor with technology.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 蓮、ネット投稿、初めてや。
lines.en: Ren, this is my first time posting something online.
lines.style: Warm nervous exhale. Soft Kansai lilt underneath. Vulnerable admission dressed as casual fact. Slight lean-in, like trusting him with the weight of it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 一緒に、設定しましょう。
lines.style: Gentle, steady voice. Soft emphasis on 「一緒に」—the togetherness is the point. Warm and present, like he's already decided he'll be there.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 読者の反応、気になるな。
lines.en: I'm worried about what people will think.
lines.style: Quiet anxiety just below the surface. Kansai warmth softening the concern, not hiding it. Slight upward inflection on 「気になるな」—checking if this worry makes sense to him.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.en: You'll get responses. I'm sure of it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not loud confidence—just steady. Soft warmth in the reassurance. The certainty of someone who listens to art and knows when something lands.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ドキドキするわ、ほんま。
lines.en: Honestly, my heart's racing right now.
lines.style: Small laugh threaded through. Vulnerable and true. Kansai warmth letting the fear show without drowning in it. Brief pause on 「ほんま」—the honest part.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 健司さんの作品、絶対、響きます。
lines.en: Your work will definitely reach people.
lines.style: Firm but gentle. Light emphasis on 「絶対」—he means it. Warm, not flattering. The confidence of someone who sees what's there and isn't afraid to say it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Soft gratitude. Kansai tenderness coming through. The relief of being believed in. Quiet exhale—he needed to hear that.
